name: The Road 66
detailed_description:
Game Description

Most teenagers who read Jack Kerouac’s On the Road dream of setting out on a spontaneous cross-country trip with their best friends. This summer, you’ll get that chance—as Kai, a high schooler from New Lake Town, you’ll dive headfirst into a surreal journey spanning the continent from east to west. What is it about Route 66 that draws people in?

In a generation that’s “spiritually lost,” rock, heavy metal, and growling vocals are already outdated. As a high schooler, knowing how to pick locks and read tarot cards isn’t exactly groundbreaking. And even if you discover that your classmate is an alien, well, in a land full of endless possibilities, that’s hardly front-page news.

On this darkly humorous adventure, you’ll slowly uncover the tangled mysteries of a decade-old secret buried in your hometown while tracing the roots of your own family history. Because you know—there’s no way those disappearances in town are just a

Game Features

  • Experience the ever-changing landscapes of a road trip

  • Interact with a variety of NPCs

  • Explore scenes through point-and-click mechanics

  • Use your wit and creativity to solve puzzles and progress the story

short_description: The Road 66 is a 2D pixel art adventure where Kai and childhood friends Sue and Nile hit the road to find the brothers' missing mother. Along Route 66, they’ll encounter talking cats, dancing fire gods, and eerie folklore. Start the engine—adventure awaits!

  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit versions only)
  • Processor: Intel Core Duo E6600 @ 2.4GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel 4400, GeForce GT 8800, AMD Radeon HD 4650
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400s @ 2.5 GHz or AMD FX-6350 @ 3.9 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD R9 280X
